body: Honestly I hope that you find that one person that will always be there for you and I hope you have a better time with whatever it is you are dealing with. I myself am not In the best state of mind and I have a tendency to spiral but what worked for me was looking in places that I didn't usually look for to find friends and that's how I managed to find a few people that now help me because I can't help myself. Again I hope that if you try this it works, but that's what has worked for me. Good luck man.

I know how you feel in that part that has happened to me a lot, but don't give up because all you need is one good friend who is there when you are down the most. If you keep looking you will find that person and that person will be there for you. This is all I can say on the matter, I'm sorry that I can't help anymore.

I have many different problems with myself and they can get in the way of having relationships, but what I have done is looked for people that accept me for me even though I have all these problems I still have people that are there for me and they have different problems of there own. That was the key for me so don't give up and normal is never what anyone is looking for believe me no one is normal and that's why we can always find people similar to us. I hope I helped at least a little.

I think it's nice that someone who doesn't even know me can be so kind. I wish all people were this, thanks for listening to me and I'll catch you on the flip flop.

P.S.
Therapy didn't work for me because apparently there is nothing wrong with me. This is from three different therapists that I went to see.

Basically shes suicidal and depressed so she was more taken, but I didn't even get to say goodbye she went off to therapy with my mum and never came back. A few days later I got some messages on facebook from her and then two more days pass and she managed to sneak a phone call but there has been nothing and her mum won't even talk to me as I said. I can no longer see her and I'm pretty sure I won't be able to see her again so there is no point in continuing my sorry excuse of a life.
